svg.text: DECOUPLED STORE-AND-FORWARD DUAL-PORT BRAM PIPELINE ARCHITECTURE
Zero-DMA Interconnect ── PS Memory Staging via AXI BRAM Controllers ── Decoupled PL Accelerators @ 100 MHz

g.text: AXI4 INTERCONNECT (M_AXI_GP0 ── 32-bit Memory-Mapped Bus @ 100 MHz FCLK1)
• Tag Bit 1: Literal byte (8 bits) ── Tag Bit 0: Back-reference (offset + length)
• 32-bit Word Accumulator ── Byte-level BRAM Port B Write Interface
COPROCESSOR 2: aes_accel (128-bit Iterative AES Counter Mode)
• State: E_K(IV [95:0] || 32-bit Counter) ── Multi-word Keystream Buffer (128 bits)
• On-the-Fly XOR with Plaintext from BRAM Port B ── Output BRAM Write
